name: Each book's de-vigged probabilities sum to 1.0
description: The per-match odds artifact stores de-vigged implied probabilities for every bookmaker. De-vigging removes the bookmaker margin so the three outcome probabilities for any single book must sum to 1.0. A naive build that skips de-vigging (probabilities summing to >1.0) fails this test.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match-odds/<first-id>.json using the captured id (the per-match odds artifact)
Inspect the books array and read each book's devigged.home, devigged.draw and devigged.away values

Verify that for every book in the artifact the three de-vigged probabilities (home + draw + away) sum to 1.0 within a tolerance of plus or minus 0.001. Any book whose de-vigged probabilities sum to more than 1.001 (the bookmaker margin was not removed) fails this test.
